# HDTube Saver

> HDTube Saver is a free online YouTube video and audio downloader. Download YouTube videos in HD quality, convert to MP4, extract audio as MP3, and choose from multiple resolutions and formats. No installation required - works directly in your browser.

## Key Features

- Download YouTube videos in HD (720p, 1080p)
- Convert YouTube videos to MP4 format
- Extract audio from YouTube videos as MP3
- Multiple quality options (240p to 1080p)
- Fast, free, and no registration required
- Works on desktop and mobile browsers

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://hdtube-saver.netlify.app/) - Main download tool
- [FAQ](https://hdtube-saver.netlify.app/faq) - Frequently asked questions
- [Privacy Policy](https://hdtube-saver.netlify.app/privacy-policy) - Privacy policy
- [Terms of Service](https://hdtube-saver.netlify.app/terms-of-service) - Terms of service

## Usage

1. Copy a YouTube video URL
2. Paste it into the input field on the homepage
3. Click "Search" to fetch video details
4. Select your preferred format (Video or Audio)
5. Click "Download" to save the file

## Technical Details

- Frontend: Angular 11 (TypeScript)
- Backend: Node.js (Express)
- Video Processing: yt-dlp
- Audio Conversion: FFmpeg
- Deployment: Vercel (frontend) + Render (backend)
